# Ranker

> > Ranker is a crowdsourced ranking platform where millions of users vote on lists covering entertainment, sports, celebrities, pop culture, and everything in between.

Ranker uses a proprietary voting algorithm to create dynamic, user-driven rankings across thousands of topics. The platform serves both consumers seeking curated lists and businesses through Ranker Business Solutions, offering data-driven insights for brands, publishers, and agencies.

## Key Topics

- Crowdsourced rankings
- User-voted lists
- Entertainment rankings
- Pop culture
- Celebrity rankings
- Sports rankings
- YouTube channels
- Community voting
- Ranker Business Solutions
- Netflix content
- Gaming rankings
- Movie franchises
- TV series rankings
- Music artists
- Content taxonomy

- [All Categories](https://ranker.com/all-categories): Complete category directory for navigating all Ranker list topics
- [About Ranker's Voting and Ranking System](https://ranker.com/howrankingswork): Explains Ranker's voting methodology and crowd-sourced ranking algorithm

## Major Content Categories

- [Famous People List: The Top People Lists and Top 10s](https://ranker.com/list-of/people): Celebrity rankings hub featuring athletes, musicians, actors, and public figures
- [Best Rankings of Sports Teams and Players, Interesting Sports Facts, and Moments in Sports](https://ranker.com/list-of/sports): Sports rankings covering NBA, MLB, athletes, teams, and memorable moments
- [The 100+ Best Movie Series Of All Time, Ranked](https://ranker.com/crowdranked-list/5-star-movie-franchises): User-voted rankings of top film franchises like Harry Potter and Marvel MCU
- [Social Issues in America | List of Contemporary Social Problems](https://ranker.com/list/social-issues-in-america-that-you-care-about-most/mike-rothschild): Ranked list of pressing American social issues and contemporary problems
